for the State.

2.  The petitioner is seeking regular bail in connection with S.T. Case No. 269/2024 arising out of Rail Bokaro P.S. Case No.12 of 2024 dated 30.04.2024 for the alleged offences registered under Sections 302, 201/34 of Indian Penal Code pending in the Court of learned A.D.J. - IV, Bokaro.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that petitioner is in jail custody since 10.05.2024 and there is no criminal antecedent against the petitioner.

sentences.text: He submits that one of the co-accused has been granted --1-- 2025:JHHC:22523 regular bail by this Court in B.A. No.10059 of 2024.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the State opposes the prayer and submits that the petitioner happened to be the husband of the deceased.

5. Considering that one of the co-accused has granted regular bail by this Court in B.A. No.10059 of 2024 and the petitioner is in custody since 10.05.2024 and there is no criminal antecedent against the petitioner, I am inclined to grant regular bail to the petitioner.
6.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, shall be released on regular bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned A.D.J. - IV, Bokaro in connection with S.T. Case No. 269/2024 arising out of Rail Bokaro P.S. Case No.12 of 2024.
